description:
Add full dark theme (DayNight) support to the existing 'WeatherApp' project.

1. Update the app theme in 'app/src/main/res/values/themes.xml' to use a DayNight parent (e.g., Theme.Material3.DayNight.NoActionBar).
2. Create a new resource directory 'values-night' and add a 'colors.xml' file containing appropriate dark mode colors. Ensure the dark colors are meaningfully different from the light colors.
3. Modify 'MainActivity.kt' to add a theme toggle mechanism using AppCompatDelegate.setDefaultNightMode().
4. Verify the project builds successfully.
